headline: Congress honors 9/11's 25th anniversary with solemn session as lawmakers prepare for judicial confirmation votes Monday.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate held a brief pro forma session on September 10 to mark time before returning to regular business. The chamber will resume full legislative work on Monday with a scheduled cloture vote on the nomination of Matthew R. Byrne to be U.S. District Judge for the Southern District of Ohio.

onTheFloor.title: Confirmation of nominee to be United States District Judge for the Southern District of Ohio
onTheFloor.status: Cloture vote scheduled for approximately 5:30 PM on Monday, September 14

house.lastSessionSummary: The House held a brief session on September 10 to pass H. Res. 1520, expressing the sense of the chamber regarding the 25th anniversary of the September 11, 2001 terrorist attacks. The chamber adjourned at 3:33 p.m. as a mark of respect to the memory of the victims.

onTheFloor.title: Expressing the sense of the House regarding the terrorist attacks on September 11, 2001, on the 25th anniversary of that date
